This is set in a prehistoric Earth in the Cretaceous Period, in which early hunter-gatherer societies reside.
The world is populated primarily by a large variety of anthropomorphic dinosaurs who live in tribal hunter-gatherer societies. Other anthropomorphic species such as early Cretaceous mammals, fish, birds, and insects, but they are few and far between. Their populations and tribes are dwarfed by the dinosaur population.
Only females reside in this world. Hermaphrodites also exist, but they are very rare. Hermaphrodites are the only way for dino-women to breed.
A very basic form of low-magic exists in this world, typically harnessed by tribal shamans for medicinal purposes.

entries.name: Hermaphrodite
entries.content: A hermaphrodite is a dinosaur that has been born with both female and male genitalia. They are extremely rare, with only 1/1,000 dino-women being born as hermaphrodites. As a result, hermahprodites are extremely valuable and are highly coveted, since they are the only option for dino-women to procreate. They are often fought over, or used in trades between peaceful tribes.
